types.label: Landing blocked
types.description: A finished build can't land: CI failed, a conflict, or it needs you.

types.label: Kicked out of the merge queue
types.description: A PR failed its queue run and was taken out of the stack.

types.label: Merge failed
types.description: A merge attempt failed (console, auto-merge, Claude, CLI, MCP or a merge queue kick): what failed, why and what the server tries next; also when it is blocked on you or every way failed (with exactly what is missing). Resolved when it merges.

types.label: Merge retry (FYI)
types.description: Each retry the server makes on a failed merge (pull main in, Claude Code, re-run CI, merge again) and its result. Information only.
